$comment: Files no single tab may edit freely. changeRule is enforced by review, ownership by governance/tools/check-file-ownership.ps1.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Append inside the tab's own marked region only; ONE registration extension method per platform; never reorder another tab's block.
sharedFiles.reason: Every tab registers services; unmarked edits collide on every change. AddCrossBusinessReporting is the pattern.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Add DbSets in the tab's marked region; never reorder; never reformat.
sharedFiles.reason: 245 DbSets; whole-file edits guarantee conflicts.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Package and analyzer references by request only.
sharedFiles.reason: A reference change alters every tab's build.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Project additions by request only.
sharedFiles.reason: Project GUIDs conflict destructively.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Our keys only via git plumbing; never whole-file git add.
sharedFiles.reason: Files are reordered by other work; whole-file staging loses keys.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Partial insertion by request; the partial must exist or every screen breaks.
sharedFiles.reason: Shared layouts already embed cross-tab partials.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Claim a SliceId in the registry before authoring; regenerate manifest.json via scan-sql-manifest.ps1.
sharedFiles.reason: D-38 names this the canonical authored root; the manifest tooling lives beside it.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Generated artifacts and operational scripts only - NOT an authoring root after D-38.
sharedFiles.reason: deploy/sql/fresh is generated by gen_fresh_db.ps1; backup and purge are operational.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Never hand-edit; regenerate with scan-sql-manifest.ps1.
sharedFiles.reason: The file says so itself; a hand-edit desynchronises hashes from content.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Reserve the number in the ADR registry before writing.
sharedFiles.reason: ADR numbers are sparse; collisions are silent.

sharedFiles.changeRule: FROZEN in this increment. Changes only through the D-37 approved visual rollout.
sharedFiles.reason: A global override flip would restyle 327 views with no design review.

sharedFiles.changeRule: No change without pre-coordination with the owner.
sharedFiles.reason: The single GL writer; already kernel-wired once without coordination.

sharedFiles.changeRule: No change without pre-coordination with the owner.
sharedFiles.reason: The single stock writer.

sharedFiles.owner: Module workflow - TAB-6 narrow read handoff
sharedFiles.changeRule: TAB-6 may ADD read-only pending-approval readers only. The approver chain, CreateAsync, DecideAsync, approval-step writes, notifications and escalation are module-owned and must not change.
sharedFiles.reason: Carries the leave approver company boundary (87ec8fa). A read contract is needed by the cross-silo inbox, but the workflow itself is not TAB-6's to alter.

sharedFiles.owner: Module workflow - TAB-6 narrow read handoff
sharedFiles.changeRule: TAB-6 may ADD read-only pending-approval readers only. CreateAsync, DecideAsync, workflow transitions, approval writes and notification logic are module-owned and must not change.
sharedFiles.reason: Shares the approver chain with leave, including its defect guard. Same narrow read need, same restriction.

sharedFiles.owner: Integration Owner - approved shared governance infrastructure
sharedFiles.changeRule: Never hand-edit. Change the canonical dataset in docs/roadmap-v2/_generator and regenerate; every edit needs explicit owner approval (-AllowShared) and must preserve machine-enforced ownership semantics.
sharedFiles.reason: These registries ARE the ownership rules the checker reads. There is no operational TAB-0 to own them, so they are shared under owner approval rather than assigned - otherwise no ownership ruling can be landed reviewably at all.

sharedFiles.owner: Integration Owner - approved shared governance infrastructure
sharedFiles.changeRule: Changes require explicit owner approval (-AllowShared) and must not weaken the ownership checker or its exit codes.
sharedFiles.reason: The enforcement tooling itself. A tab that could silently relax check-file-ownership.ps1 could grant itself any path.

sharedFiles.changeRule: No change without pre-coordination with the owner.
sharedFiles.reason: The single outbox writer; the per-consumer fan-out is decided here, so one edit changes what every consumer ever sees.

sharedFiles.owner: Module surface - integration owner unblock only
sharedFiles.changeRule: Company-context remediation of named read paths only. No posting, stock, journal, receivable or payment behaviour may change under this entry.
sharedFiles.reason: Invoice read paths still resolve company from a compile-time constant while the product surface above them is company-scoped; TAB-7 is unassigned so the screens cannot be fixed by their owner.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Shared by three committed document views; changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: Three committed views include this partial and it was never committed, so a clean checkout throws partial-not-found on both invoice detail screens and the work order screen.
